Uses of Enum Class
io.github.jabrena.juno.board.Board

Packages that use Board
Package
Description
io.github.jabrena.juno
Juno's top-level compiler entry points: the CLI, the embeddable compiler API, and the small value types that connect them.
io.github.jabrena.juno.analysis
Control-flow structure and conservative resource/runtime-risk analysis over decoded bytecode.
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.avr
The AVR code generator: AvrAsmBackend emits avr-gcc assembly for the ATmega4809 UNO WiFi Rev2, calling the runtime shim through generated word-interface thunks.
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.thumb2
The Thumb-2 code generator: Thumb2AsmBackend emits GNU ARM Thumb-2 assembly for the Cortex-M4 UNO R4 WiFi and the Cortex-M33 UNO Q, one generator for both cores.
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.xtensa
The Xtensa code generator: XtensaAsmBackend emits GNU Xtensa assembly for the Nano ESP32's ESP32-S3, calling the runtime shim directly through the windowed-register ABI.
io.github.jabrena.juno.board
Juno's model of a compilation target: Board, resolved from the entry-point class's @Board annotation (see Board) via Board.fromApiClassName(String), or the explicitly requested board when the entry point carries no annotation.
io.github.jabrena.juno.linker
Closed-world reachability: starting at main, follows every statically resolvable call, resolves hardware intrinsics, and rejects anything reachable that falls outside Juno's supported subset — before any code generation is attempted.
io.github.jabrena.juno.lowering
Lowers linked, reachable JVM bytecode into Juno's IR.
